subject: Is there (could there be) a reactive boolean to indicate that the UI has finished rendering?

messages.author: 912329a6ad1a6995
messages.subject: Is there (could there be) a reactive boolean to indicate that the UI has finished rendering?
parts:
Hi,

I'm using Dean Attali's nifty shinyjs package, but I have run across an issue when using enable/disable of dynamic elements.

I'm not the first one to come across this; great writeup of the issue here:

https://github.com/daattali/shinyjs/issues/25

To highlight one of the questions raised there, I was just wondering if there is (or if there could be) a reactive available that indicates when the html has finished rendering?

Thanks,

Ian

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Is there (could there be) a reactive boolean to indicate that the UI has finished rendering?
parts:
As Dean said, we have been working on this. You will be able to know
if an output has finished rendering (hopefully in the next version of
shiny).

Regards,
Yihui
